news.headline: Johnson (ankle) was listed as a non-participant on Monday's estimated practice report.
news.story: The running back injured his ankle on kickoff coverage in the first quarter of Sunday's game against the Saints and had to be carted off. He'll have two more chances to get on the practice field ahead of Thursday's matchup with the Lions, but he does not appear likely to play at this point. D'Andre Swift and Kyle Monangai are healthy at the top of Chicago's running back depth chart.

news.headline: Johnson (ankle) has been ruled out for the rest of Sunday's game against the Saints, Courtney Cronin of ESPN.com reports.
news.story: Johnson injured his ankle while on kickoff coverage early in the first quarter. He was carted off the field, and medical staff have determined that the injury is severe enough for Johnson to be sidelined for the rest of Sunday's contest. Salvon Ahmed will move into the RB3 role behind D'Andre Swift and Kyle Monangai in Johnson's absence.

news.headline: Johnson exited Sunday's game versus the Saints due to an ankle injury and is doubtful to return.
news.story: Johnson was carted to the locker room in the first quarter after sustaining the injury on kick coverage. With Kyle Monangai (toe) back in action Sunday, Johnson was poised to be primarily a special teamer in Week 11, but he now appears as if he's dealing with a serious health concern.

Rivers rushed 15 straight times before Matthew Stafford performed a pair of kneel-downs to end the game. It will be interesting to see if Rivers' efficiency was enough to earn him more carries before garbage time moving forward, especially after Kyren…

Bernard entered Week 10 having recorded multiple receptions in five straight contests, and he'll have a good shot to get back on track in Week 11 versus the Eagles.

news.story: Per Daniel Oyefusi of ESPN, prior to that Concepcion was slow to get up after dropping a deep pass from QB Deshaun Watson. The rookie WR has one catch for six yards (on four targets) to his credit thus far in Sunday's contest.

news.headline: Boston caught just one pass for 16 yards on two targets in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Texans.
news.story: The rookie wideout entered play Sunday dealing with a toe injury and appeared to aggravate it versus Houston. At less than 100 percent health, Boston was unproductive in the box score and saw a microscopic five percent target share. After popping back up for 6-98-0 receiving last Sunday in New Orleans with Shedeur Sanders at quarterback, Boston reverted to his sluggish ways with Deshaun Watson in Week 10. Over his…

news.headline: Boston (toe) is listed as active for Sunday's game against the Texans, Kelsey Russo of The Athletic reports.

news.story: After missing practice Wednesday and Thursday, Boston returned to a limited session Friday, with coach Todd Monken noting that the WR was "trending in the right way." Now, assuming no setbacks in warmups, it appears as though Boston will be available versus Houston, with his official game status set to be confirmed once Cleveland's inactives are posted about 90 minutes before Sunday's 1 pm ET kickoff.

news.headline: With Brock Bowers (ankle/quad) inactive for Sunday's game against the Broncos, Mayer is in line to see an expanded role in Week 11.

Bowers was held to 18 yards by the Seahawks during Fernando Mendoza's first regular-season start in Week 10 after mustering at least 70 receiving yards in each of his seven games with Kirk Cousins.

Now, Wilson will yield all the RB reps to Charbonnet, Price and George Holani in Week 10.

news.headline: Thompson (hamstring) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Jets.

news.story: Thompson has been sidelined by a hamstring injury and has not seen regular-season action since Week 2 against the Raiders. If he's ruled out for Sunday's game, then the rookie fourth-rounder's next chance to play would be Week 12 against the Patriots on Sunday, Nov. 29.

news.story: Thompson will not suit up for Monday's primetime clash after being listed as doubtful following a third consecutive DNP on Saturday, and it's no surprise the fourth-round rookie is unable to play in Monday's game. news.headline: Armstrong caught his only target for a 43-yard touchdown in Sunday's 35-13 win over the Falcons.
news.story: The wideout played just 17 of 64 offensive snaps against Atlanta and ran only seven pass routes on Patrick Mahomes' 38 dropbacks. Armstrong was tasked with blocking duties on 10 of his snaps. He still managed to catch his first career touchdown in the fourth quarter with the game already well out of hand. Armstrong is not on the fantasy radar.

news.headline: Watkins caught one of his three targets for 26 yards during the Colts' 26-3 loss to the Texans on Thursday night.
news.story: Watkins played just five offensive snaps for the Colts in Thursday night's game. Despite playing only 10 percent of the offensive snaps, Watkins totaled the third-highest yardage by Colts pass catchers on the night with his 26-yard grab. The reserve wide receiver could see an expanded role down the stretch as the Colts experiment with starting quarterback Anthony Richardson in what is all but a lost season.

news.story: A spot on the 53-man roster opened up when Indianapolis placed linebacker Jaylon Carlies (neck) on IR, and the team elected to give Watkins the opening. news.headline: Milton completed 11 of 21 passes for 141 yards while rushing five times for seven yards in Sunday's 19-16 win over the Steelers.
news.story: Milton has thrown for just 310 yards without a touchdown pass or interception through two starts. news.headline: Singleton (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Cowboys.
news.story: Week 11 marks the fifth time in six games that Singleton will be a healthy scratch, despite the fact that Tyjae Spears (knee) was placed on injured reserve Saturday. Singleton's next opportunity to play is Week 12 against the Jaguars on Nov. 29.

news.headline: Singleton (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Jaguars.

news.story: With Ladd McConkey (back) active, Lambert-Smith will be a healthy scratch for Sunday's contest. Lambert-Smith's next opportunity to suit up is Week 12 against the Patriots on Nov. 29, although his path to playing time is limited unless there is an injury in front of him on the Chargers' wide receiver depth chart.

news.headline: Sarratt (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against Carolina.
news.story: Sarratt has been active for two games this season, most recently appearing in Week 4 versus the Titans. Since then, he's been held out. His next opportunity to play will come in Week 12 versus the Texans.

news.headline: Coach Aaron Glenn said Friday that Cooper (ankle/hip) will be out for Sunday's game against the Chargers, Brian Costello of the New York Post reports.
news.story: Cooper didn't practice Wednesday or Thursday due to a pair of injuries, and he'll wind up sitting out Week 11. news.story: Cooper made an early exit from this past Sunday's 31-12 loss to the Bills after injuring his right ankle, and the rookie wideout is also nursing a hip issue as the Jets prepare for a matchup this weekend with the Chargers. With two straight absences from practice to begin the week, Cooper will likely need to get in at least a limited session Friday to have any chance at suiting up Sunday.

news.headline: Cooper (ankle) isn't practicing Wednesday, Brian Costello of the New York Post reports.
news.story: Cooper logged just one snap this past Sunday against the Bills after tweaking the same ankle he hurt in Week 1, which led to an IR stint. The rookie WR will now have two more chances to practice this week, but if he's sidelined this weekend against the Chargers, Garrett Wilson and Adonai Mitchell would likely be busy in Week 11, with Isaiah Williams (seven targets versus Buffalo) also factoring in.

news.headline: The Seahawks placed Holani (knee) on injured reserve Monday, John Boyle of the team's official site reports.
news.story: Holani was knocked out of the Seahawks' last game in Week 10 at Las Vegas due to a knee injury that eventually was deemed to be an MCL sprain. With his placement on IR, he'll miss at least the next four contests, meaning his next chance for game action is Friday, Dec. 25 against the Rams. In the meantime, Emanuel Wilson will serve as the team's No. 3 RB behind Zach Charbonnet and Jadarian Price.

news.story: Holani exited Sunday's Week 10 game against the Raiders after suffering a knee injury. The 26-year-old is not currently expected to be placed on injured reserve, but he will be reevaluated after Seattle's Week 11 bye. The three-year pro has had a larger role on special teams since Zach Charbonnet and Jadarian Price returned from injuries to helm Seattle's ground attack.

news.headline: Holani (knee) has been ruled out for the remainder of Sunday's game against the Seahawks.
news.story: Holani exited the first quarter of Sunday's contest with a knee injury. The running back will not return, leaving another player to fill his special-teams role as Jadarian Price and Zach Charbonnet continue to dominate the Seahawks' running game.

news.headline: Klein secured all four targets for 24 yards and a touchdown in the Texans' 26-3 win over the Colts on Thursday.
news.story: Klein surprisingly outpaced veteran position mates Dalton Schultz and Foster Moreau on the night, and the rookie second-round pick, whose only other career reception coming in was a 16-yard grab in Week 1, added his first career touchdown on a 13-yard catch in the third quarter. news.headline: Wayne (quadriceps) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Bills, David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

news.story: Wayne sat out Sunday's game at Indianapolis with a quad injury, and his availability for Week 11 is now in question. If he's not able to get back onto the practice field Thursday or Friday, he'll be trending toward missing Sunday's game at Buffalo.

news.headline: Patrick (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Bills.
news.story: Garrett Wilson (concussion), Omar Cooper (ankle) and Adonai Mitchell (knee) have all been cleared to play Sunday, so Patrick will observe from the sidelines. Patrick hasn't played since Week 7 against the Dolphins, and his next opportunity to suit up is Week 11 against the Chargers on Nov. 22.

news.headline: Williams (ribs) won't play in Sunday's game against the Chargers.
news.story: With Omar Cooper (ankle/hip) also slated to be unavailable for the contest, Garrett Wilson and Adonai Mitchell will lead the Jets' Week 11 WR corps, with coach Aaron Glenn noting Friday that the team's tight ends, primarily Kenyon Sadiq and Mason Taylor, should have an opportunity to see added opportunities as pass catchers this weekend in the absence of both Cooper and Williams.

news.headline: Williams (ribs) was a non-participant in Thursday's practice.
news.story: The Jets' wideout depth could be tested in Sunday's game against the Chargers, as both Williams and Omar Cooper (ankle/hip) have been sidelined for the team's first two Week 11 practices. Both receivers will likely need to practice in some fashion Friday to avoid being ruled out ahead of the weekend. If neither Williams nor Cooper can suit up against the Chargers, Malik McClain and Tim Patrick would be the…

news.headline: Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said that Williams won't practice Wednesday due to a rib injury, Eric Allen of the Jets' official site reports.
news.story: New York will be without two of its wideouts to begin Week 11 prep, as rookie Omar Cooper (ankle) is also sidelined for Wednesday's practice. Williams drew a season-high seven targets in this past Sunday's 31-12 loss to the Bills, finishing with four catches for 24 yards across 50 offensive snaps while apparently picking up an injury at some point along the way.

news.headline: Sturdivant caught two passes for 37 yards and a touchdown on four targets in Sunday's 30-10 loss to the Vikings.
news.story: After Green Bay was shut out in the first half, Sturdivant's first career touchdown came in the third quarter from 32 yards out, and it went down as the Packers' lone touchdown of the afternoon. Sturdivant played just nine offensive snaps as the fourth receiver and would need more than one injury ahead of him on the depth chart to be relevant in fantasy.

Williams failed to haul in his lone target during the Patriots' 35-10 loss to the Lions on Sunday in Munich.
news.story: Williams did have a 21-yard carry late in the third quarter, although the play was nullified by offsetting penalties. It was the second straight game that the second-year wide receiver did not record a catch and the fifth time in 10 regular-season contests. New England is on a bye for Week 11, but the offense's outlook looks grim given that franchise quarterback Drake Maye is expected to miss time due to an ankle…

news.headline: Watkins brought in his lone target for 19 yards during the 49ers' 35-10 win over the Vikings on Sunday.
news.story: Watkins' 28 offensive snaps were tied with Deebo Samuel for second-most among 49ers wide receivers behind Keenan Allen (31) and ahead of Mike Evans (23). Watkins has played at least 50 percent of San Francisco's offensive snaps in each of the team's last five games, but the second-year pro is stuck in a complementary role on offense behind Evans, Allen, Samuel, tight end George Kittle and running back Christian…

news.headline: Watkins caught two passes for 49 yards on three targets in Sunday's 46-40 win over the Cowboys.
news.story: With Deebo Samuel still working his way back to 100 percent off his hamstring injury, Keenan Allen being eased in after his acquisition from the Colts and Mike Evans (Achilles) remaining inactive, Watkins' 44 snaps led San Francisco's wideouts. However, his three targets were a distant fourth on the team and represented just a 10.7 percent share. Allen will likely play more moving forward, and Evans is expected…

news.headline: Ahmed reverted to the Bears' practice squad Monday, according to the NFL's official transaction log.
news.story: The running back was elevated from the practice squad Saturday ahead of Sunday's game against New Orleans, and he carried the ball six times for 33 yards across 10 offensive snaps. Ahmed saw action late in the third quarter and into the fourth, after Roschon Johnson exited the game with an ankle injury in the first quarter. Both are behind D'Andre Swift and Kyle Monangai on the depth chart.

news.headline: The Bears elevated Ahmed from the practice squad Saturday.
news.story: Even with Kyle Monangai (toe) back from his toe injury for Sunday's game against New Orleans, Ahmed is up as the Bears' fourth running back, though he could be active ahead of Roschon Johnson, who played behind Ahmed in Week 9 against the Bucs.

news.headline: Gilliam (knee) is active for Sunday's game against the Lions in Munich.
news.story: Gilliam took a questionable tag into Sunday, but the Patriots' decision to activate him from injured reserve Saturday signaled that he was on track to play for the first time since Week 4. The fullback served almost exclusively as a blocker when he was healthy during the Patriots' first four games of the season, logging no carries and recording a four-yard reception on two targets.

news.headline: The Patriots activated Gilliam (knee), who remains questionable for Sunday's game against Detroit, from injured reserve Saturday, Doug Kyed of the Boston Herald reports.
news.story: Gilliam landed on IR on Oct. 10 and had his 21-day practice window opened Wednesday. By coming off injured reserve Saturday, the veteran fullback has a chance to suit up Sunday, though he remains officially questionable. Gilliam was limited in all three of New England's practice this week.

news.headline: Wallace caught both of his two targets for nine yards during Sunday's 27-24 win versus the Texans. He also recorded one tackle in kick coverage.
news.story: Wallace again played a rotational role in Week 10, logging 13 snaps at wide receiver. He was able to draw a season-high two targets and come down with both of them, making him one of eight Browns to catch a pass from quarterback Deshaun Watson Sunday. Barring an injury to one of the wideouts ahead of him on the depth chart, he doesn't have a clear path to more consistent playing time following Cleveland's bye in…

news.headline: Hunter caught his lone target for three yards, added a nine-yard carry and logged six tackles (four solo) during the Jaguars' 23-18 loss to the Giants on Sunday.
news.story: As has been the case for most of the 2026 season, Hunter spent the majority of his time on the field playing defense, and his six tackles were fourth-most on the Jaguars. He had a quiet day offensively, and the second-year pro is up to a 10-94-1 receiving line on 11 targets through 10 regular-season games. On the defensive side of the ball, Hunter is up to 42 tackles (28 solo) and seven pass defenses (including…

news.headline: Hunter caught both of his targets for 16 yards, recorded a three-yard carry and contributed five tackles (three solo) and an interception during the Jaguars' 40-23 win over the Titans on Sunday.
news.story: Fifty-six of Hunter's 62 snaps Sunday came on defense, and that's where he made his biggest impact with a diving interception on a Cam Ward pass intended for Elic Ayomanor, and the Jaguars offense converted that takeaway into a field goal 10 plays later. Hunter's impact on both sides of the ball has been undeniable: he has 28 catches (on 45 targets) for 298 yards and a touchdown, along with 36 tackles (24 solo) and…

news.headline: Gipson was signed by the Giants off of Philadelphia's practice squad Monday, Pat Leonard of the New York Daily News reports.
news.story: Gipson will head to New York after spending the entirety of the 2026 campaign to this point on the Eagles' practice squad. The Giants waived primary kick and punt returner Charlie Jones on Monday, and Gipson will likely take over that role beginning in Week 11 against the Jaguars.

news.headline: Allen caught his lone target for a 19-yard touchdown in Sunday's win over the Cardinals.
news.story: With all three of Puka Nacua (knee/toe), Davante Adams (hamstring) and Terrance Ferguson (hamstring) out, the Rams leaned on their tight-end triumvirate of Tyler Higbee, Colby Parkinson and Allen, as all three played more offensive snaps than any of the Los Angeles wideouts. Parkinson (53 snaps) led the way, followed by Allen (52) and Higbee (51), and both Allen and Higbee caught touchdowns. Allen, however, ran…

news.headline: Allen (oblique) is active for Sunday's game against the Cardinals.
news.story: Allen has recovered enough from the oblique injury he suffered during the Rams' Week 9 win over the Commanders to suit up for Week 10. The No. 3 tight end is a key part of the Rams' 13-personnel offense, and he should continue seeing a significant share of offensive snaps for the team.

news.headline: The Colts ruled out Mallory (hamstring) for Thursday night's games against the Texans.
news.story: Mallory was absent from practice all week heading into Thursday night's divisional showdown versus Houston. This marks the 27-year-old's third straight missed game. He has caught two of nine targets for 20 yards in three games during the 2026 season.

news.headline: Mallory (hamstring) was estimated as a non-participant for Tuesday's practice walkthrough.
news.story: Tuesday was the second straight day that the Colts held a walkthrough instead of a traditional practice, and Mallory was deemed a DNP in both cases. It's looking increasingly unlikely that the tight end will be able to play Thursday versus Houston, though he could give himself a chance to suit up if he's able to show improvement over the next day. Should Mallory be out Thursday, Drew Ogletree and Pharaoh Brown…

news.headline: Mallory (hamstring) did not participate in Monday's walkthrough practice.
news.story: Mallory suffered a hamstring injury during Week 10 prep, and he was not cleared to play in the Colts' 24-22 win over the Dolphins on Sunday. Indianapolis is operating on a short week, so Mallory faces an uphill battle to play against the Texans on Thursday.

news.headline: Week 11 winners and losers: Cowboys put up points while Josh Allen does not
Goff completed 20 of 28 passes for 279 yards with two touchdowns and no interceptions while adding five rushes for 12 yards in the Lions' 31-21 win over the Buccaneers on Sunday.
news.story: Goff put together an efficient effort on an afternoon when he recorded completions to eight different targets. The veteran signal-caller hit Amon-Ra St. Brown (14 yards) and Jameson Williams (57 yards) for his pair of touchdown passes, and he has multiple scoring strikes in two straight. Goff boasts a sparkling 20:4 TD:INT heading into a Thanksgiving Day showdown against the Bears at Ford Field on Thursday.

news.headline: Goff completed 20 of 31 passes for 303 yards and three touchdowns with two interceptions in Sunday's 35-10 win over the Patriots in Munich. He added three yards on his only carry.
news.story: A potential barn burner versus Drake Maye never materialized when the New England quarterback left the game early with an ankle injury, but Goff and the Detroit offense still held up their end of the bargain. Two of Goff's TDs went to Amon-Ra St. Brown, including a 56-yard catch-and-run score in the first quarter, while Isaac TeSlaa also hauled in a 12-yard score in the second. Goff will take an 18:4 TD:INT through…

news.headline: Rodgers completed 30 of 44 passes for 227 yards and one touchdown while rushing five times for 29 yards in Sunday's 19-16 loss to the Eagles.
news.story: Rodgers threw a 20-yard touchdown pass to Max Hurleman on Pittsburgh's final offensive play with 1:21 remaining in the fourth quarter, but that was too little too late, as the Eagles proceeded to run out the clock to drop the Steelers to 6-4. Hurleman stepped up down the stretch in his first NFL game after starting wide receiver DK Metcalf was disqualified. Rodgers had a four-game stretch in which he threw 11…

McCord completed 12 of 33 passes for 102 yards, no touchdowns and one interception in Sunday's 26-9 loss to the Bills. He also rushed twice for nine yards.
news.story: McCord has thrown for just 311 yards without a touchdown pass in his first two NFL starts. The 2025 sixth-round pick of the Eagles is poised to make at least two more starts while Malik Willis (abdomen) is on IR. Miami's lone win of the season came against the Jets, whom the Dolphins will host in Week 12.

news.headline: McCord completed 17 of 32 passes for 209 yards with no touchdowns or interceptions and rushed twice for four yards and a touchdown in the Dolphins' 24-22 loss to the Colts on Sunday. He also lost a fumble that was returned for a touchdown.
news.story: Drawing his first career start as a result of Malik Willis having gone on injured reserve with an abdomen injury earlier in the week, McCord acquitted himself well overall in a favorable matchup. The 2025 sixth-round pick of the Eagles spread the ball around to nine different targets, and he had a statement three-yard touchdown run on the first play of the fourth quarter when he powered through a pair of defenders…

news.headline: Trevor Lawrence dimes Brian Thomas Jr. for a Jags TD
Thomas caught one pass for an 18-yard touchdown on three targets in Sunday's 23-18 loss to the Giants.
news.story: Thomas' three targets were a distant fourth on the team, as Parker Washington (17), Jakobi Meyers (10) and Josh Cameron (seven) combined to see a combined 34 looks on Trevor Lawrence's 47 pass attempts. Thomas ran 32 routes, 14 more than Cameron as the Jaguars' nominal WR3, but the former hasn't been seeing meaningful target volume for months. After drawing nine targets in Week 2, Thomas has averaged 2.1 targets…

news.headline: Thomas caught three of four targets for 29 yards in Sunday's 40-23 win over the Titans.
news.story: The three catches tied his season high, while the four targets represented his biggest volume since Week 2. The Jaguars' decision not to deal Thomas at the trade deadline remains a curious one, as the third-year wideout simply doesn't have a significant role in Liam Coen's offense and might not step into one even if someone like Parker Washington got injured -- Josh Cameron was more productive Sunday on three…

news.headline: Horton failed to garner a target during Sunday's 21-13 win over the Raiders.
news.story: Horton failed to reel in a pass for the first time since Week 7, and his 10 offensive snaps ranked fourth at wide receiver for Seattle behind Jaxon Smith-Njigba (43), Cooper Kupp (35) and Rashid Shaheed (25). Horton will continue to be an unappealing fantasy option as long as he's buried below the other three wideouts on the depth chart.

news.headline: KaVontae Turpin breaks free for a Cowboys touchdown

Turpin failed to reel in his only target while rushing twice for 41 yards and a touchdown during Sunday's 51-30 win over the Titans. He added 121 yards as a kick returner and logged a 13-yard punt return.
news.story: Turpin went without a catch for the fourth time this season, but he was able to make his mark as a rusher in Week 11. The wideout was able to break loose for a 22-yard rushing touchdown in the first quarter, notching his second score on the ground this season. Turpin has now caught five of 11 targets for 49 yards, rushed five times for 60 yards and two touchdowns, and added 695 kick-return yards and 121 yards as a…

news.headline: Turpin is expected to resume return duties on both kickoffs and punts Sunday against the Titans, Calvin Watkins of The Dallas Morning News reports.
news.story: The wide receiver had to sit for three games with a rib injury before coming back for last Sunday's loss to the 49ers, in which he fielded punts but not kickoffs. Turpin has 574 kickoff-return yards and 108 punt-return yards on the year.

news.headline: Young (stinger) is questionable to return to Sunday's contest against Denver.
news.story: Young suffered a stinger late in the first half, and his availability for the rest of the game is now in question. In his absence, Cody White is a candidate to see a slight uptick in opportunities on offense with Las Vegas.

news.headline: Young went without a target while playing one of the Raiders' 59 snaps on offense in Sunday's 21-13 loss to the Seahawks. He also brought back one kickoff for 29 yards.
news.story: Young has suited up in each of the Raiders' 10 games this season, but he's been deployed almost exclusively on special teams. He's seen single-digit snaps on offense in five straight games and has posted a collective 2-36-0 receiving line on three targets on the campaign.

news.headline: Restrepo caught his lone target for five yards in Sunday's 51-30 loss to the Cowboys.
news.story: Even with Wan'Dale Robinson (ankle) out, Restrepo played as the Titans' WR5 against Dallas, as his 17 offensive snaps trailed all four of Carnell Tate (61), Chimere Dike (53), Elic Ayomanor (36) and Calvin Ridley (26) in terms of playing time. Restrepo played 11 of his 13 snaps on pass plays in the slot, where Robinson operated prior to his injury, but it was actually Dike and Daniel Bellinger who saw the biggest…

news.headline: Restrepo, whom the Titans signed off their practice squad Tuesday, could be in store for more playing time out of the slot moving forward after Tennessee placed Wan'Dale Robinson (ankle) on injured reserve, Mark Mihalko of USA Today reports.
news.story: A 2025 undrafted free agent who played alongside Cam Ward during their final collegiate seasons at Miami, Restrepo showed immediate chemistry with the Titans' second-year quarterback during a 40-23 loss to the Jaguars in Week 10. Restrepo went on to play 19 snaps following Robinson's exit late in the third quarter and notched three receptions for 31 yards on three targets over the game's final 10 minutes. While the…

news.headline: Restrepo was signed to the Titans' active roster Tuesday, Jim Wyatt of the team's official website reports.
news.story: Restrepo was elevated to the active roster in Week 10 against the Jaguars, and he reeled in all three of his targets for 31 yards over 19 offensive snaps. After fellow wide receiver Wan'Dale Robinson (ankle) was placed on injured reserve Tuesday, Restrepo will replace him on the active roster ahead of Sunday's matchup with the Cowboys.

news.headline: Benson (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Seahawks.
news.story: Benson is a healthy scratch for a third consecutive week. The rookie sixth-rounder has failed to find a place in a wide-open receiving corps so far, and it remains to be seen how coach Klint Kubiak will utilize him.

news.headline: Shavers was targeted twice for zero catches and logged one tackle on kick coverage in the Bills' 26-9 win over the Dolphins on Sunday.
news.story: Shavers played 27 offensive snaps and 16 special-teams in his return to the field Sunday. The wide receiver has finally started to mix into the offense after recovering from the torn ACL he suffered in the Bills' 27-24 win over the Jaguars in the 2025 AFC wild-card round.

news.headline: Shavers (knee) is active for Sunday's game against the Dolphins.
news.story: Shavers was activated from the reserve/PUP list Saturday, and the San Diego State product has been officially cleared to play Sunday in what will be his first game since the Bills AFC wild-card round win over the Jaguars in January, when he tore his ACL. Shavers will likely operate in a rotational role on offense behind DJ Moore, Khalil Shakir and Keon Coleman.

news.headline: Bills head coach Joe Brady said Wednesday that Shavers (knee) has been reinstated from the PUP list, Katherine Fitzgerald of The Buffalo News reports.
news.story: Shavers' 21-day evaluation window was set to close this week, so the Bills elected to add him back to the 53-man roster to ensure that he would be available to play this season. The wideout has been a full practice participant for the past two weeks, so he appears to be fully recovered from the torn ACL he sustained in January and should be available for Sunday's game against the Dolphins. If active for the Week 11…

news.headline: Humphrey (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against Las Vegas.
news.story: Humphrey will be a healthy scratch for a second consecutive game. His next chance to play is Week 12 against the Steelers on Black Friday, although Humphrey is unlikely to see the field unless a wide receiver ahead of him on the depth chart is not available.

news.headline: Larison turned his lone carry into two yards and caught two of three targets for 15 yards and a touchdown during the Patriots' 35-10 loss to the Lions on Sunday in Munich. He also recorded a tackle on special teams.
news.story: The Patriots lost starting quarterback Drake Maye to an ankle injury early in the first quarter, so backup Tommy DeVito was under center for most of contest. New England struggled with DeVito at the helm, but he did connect with Larison for a 10-yard touchdown pass early in the fourth quarter in what was the Patriots' lone trip to the end zone. Even though that score came in garbage time, it was the first touchdown…

news.headline: LaPorta (ankle) was limited at Monday's walkthrough, Nolan Bianchi of The Detroit News reports.
news.story: With a Thanksgiving matchup on tap against the Bears, the Lions are easing into the week following Sunday's 31-21 win against the Buccaneers, when LaPorta gathered in three of six targets for 62 yards. He's nursing an ankle issue in the wake of that contest, and he may need to be listed as full Tuesday and/or Wednesday in order to avoid a designation ahead of Thursday's game.

news.headline: LaPorta brought in three of six targets for 62 yards in the Lions' 31-21 win over the Buccaneers on Sunday.
news.story: LaPorta helped set the tone for the Lions early with an impressive 47-yard catch and run down the middle of the field on Detroit's second play from scrimmage. The yardage total was the talented tight end's highest since Week 5, and it enabled him to finish second on the day for the Lions in that category behind Jameson Williams. LaPorta now boasts a 39-477-3 line on 59 targets heading into Thursday's Thanksgiving…

news.headline: Fantasy football matchup ranks: Upgrade Jonah Coleman, downgrade Brock Purdy
Ridley caught five of six targets for 68 yards and a touchdown during Sunday's 51-30 loss to the Cowboys.
news.story: Ridley reeled in multiple passes in a contest for the first time since Week 5, and his 12-yard touchdown connection with Cam Ward in the fourth quarter was the wideout's first score of the year. Ridley trailed only fellow wide receiver Chimere Dike (seven) in targets, and Ridley could continue to see added opportunities moving forward with Wan'Dale Robinson (ankle) sidelined for the remainder of the 2026 campaign.

news.headline: Ridley played four offensive snaps and didn't show up on the box score otherwise during the Titans' 40-23 loss to the Jaguars on Sunday.
news.story: Even though Carnell Tate (shoulder) was sidelined for a second consecutive week, Ridley was barely involved in the Titans' offensive game plan. Ridley's four offensive snaps were by far a season low, and his role figures to shrink even more given that Tate is expected to return for Week 11 against the Cowboys on Nov. 22. Wan'Dale Robinson (ankle) could be sidelined for that contest, although those offensive snaps…

news.headline: VanSumeren (knee) has been ruled out for the rest of Sunday's game against the Cardinals.
news.story: VanSumeran injured his knee in the second half, and with no other fullback on the 53-man roster, the Chiefs could turn to tight end Jake Briningstool to provide additional blocking out of the backfield. VanSumeran's status over the coming days will be worth monitoring, given that the Chiefs are operating on a short week and play against the Bills on Thanksgiving Day.

news.headline: Laube played all 22 of his snaps on special teams in Sunday's 21-13 loss to the Seahawks and returned two kickoffs for 46 yards and one punt for zero yards.
news.story: Since earning seven touches in a Week 5 blowout loss to the Patriots, Laube has been an afterthought on offense. He's played just eight total offense snaps in the Raiders' ensuing five games, and Sunday marked the first time all season that he was limited exclusively to special teams.

news.headline: Price caught both of his targets for 26 yards and collected 94 kick return yards and 19 punt return yards in the Vikings' 35-10 loss to the 49ers on Sunday.
news.story: Price played 10 offensive snaps and 10 special-teams snaps in Sunday's contest. The wide receiver was targeted on 20 percent of his reps, making the most of his offensive opportunities as the No. 5 option. Price continues to show out on special teams, with 912 kick return yards and 281 punt return yards over 10 games so far in 2026.

news.headline: Price is set for an increase in offensive workload with Jordan Addison (thumb) sidelined, Kevin Seifert of ESPN.com reports.
news.story: Price reeled in a season-high four passes for 49 yards and a score during Sunday's 30-10 win over the Packers. The wideout was operating in a more prominent offensive role for the second week in a row with Jauan Jennings (calf) sidelined, and fellow wide receiver Jordan Addison (thumb) was unable to play as well. Addison now is expected to undergo thumb surgery, opening the door for Price to operate in an elevated…

news.headline: Price caught all four targets for 49 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 30-10 win over the Packers.
news.story: With Jordan Addison (thumb) inactive, Price moved up the depth chart and played 33 of 69 offensive snaps behind Justin Jefferson (63) and Tai Felton (59) in Kirk Cousins' 2026 debut with the team. Price ended up running 22 routes on Cousins' 36 dropbacks and produced the game's first touchdown, scoring from 38 yards out in the first quarter to give Minnesota a 10-0 lead. On limited offensive playing time this…

news.headline: Cameron caught three of seven targets for 44 yards during Sunday's 23-18 loss against the Giants. He also returned two kickoffs for a total of 40 return yards.
news.story: Despite only being on the field for 25 of the Jaguars' 68 offensive snaps in Week 11, Cameron drew a career-high seven targets. He wasn't terribly efficient on those targets, but neither was Jacksonville's offense as a whole Sunday. He'll be lining up against a much softer pass defense in a Week 12 tilt versus the Titans.

news.headline: Cameron caught all three of his targets for 67 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 40-23, Week 10 win over Tennessee. He also returned five kickoffs for 142 yards.
news.story: Cameron gave the Jaguars a 14-point lead early in the fourth quarter when he hauled in a 25-yard touchdown pass from Trevor Lawrence. It was the rookie wideout's third touchdown of the campaign but his first since Week 3. Cameron's 67 receiving yards marked a career high, while his three receptions tied the most he's had as a pro. Cameron's propensity for finding the end zone (his three TDs have come on just 12…

news.headline: Stafford completed 18 of 26 passes for 249 yards with three touchdowns and one interception and rushed twice for minus-2 yards in the Rams' 34-6 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.
news.story: Stafford didn't let the fact he was without top wideouts Puka Nacua (IR, knee/toe) and Davante Adams (IR, hamstring) deter him from a very fantasy-friendly performance, as the reigning NFL MVP tossed at least three TD passes for the fourth time this season. Stafford connected with the unlikely trio of Tyler Higbee (five yards), Xavier Smith (22 yards) and Davis Allen (19 yards) for his scoring strikes, and the…

news.headline: Milton completed 11 of 21 passes for 141 yards while rushing five times for seven yards in Sunday's 19-16 win over the Steelers.
news.story: Milton has thrown for just 310 yards without a touchdown pass or interception through two starts. He rushed for just seven yards Sunday after notching 64 rushing yards against the Giants in his first start with the Eagles, but Milton avoided mistakes as the Eagles rode their defense and Saquon Barkley's legs to their third win of the season. Twelve of Milton's 21 passes were directed to DeVonta Smith (hamstring) in…

news.headline: Head coach Nick Sirianni confirmed that Milton will remain the Eagles' starting quarterback for Sunday's game against the Steelers, according to NFL reporter Andrew Siciliano.
news.story: While starting in his team debut Week 9 against the Giants, Milton was unable to bring an end to the Eagles' lengthy losing streak, but the third-year quarterback showed enough positives to retain the starting gig coming out of a Week 10 bye. Milton put an intriguing dual-threat skill set on display with 64 yards on nine carries to go with 169 passing yards on 34 attempts in the 19-11 loss to New York, with the…

news.headline: Allen logged 80 kick return yards in the Dolphins' 26-9 loss to the Bills on Sunday.
news.story: Allen played 16 special-teams snaps in the contest. The running back did not log an offensive snap, leaving all the rushing work to Ollie Gordon and Jaylen Wright.

news.headline: Allen turned his lone carry into zero yards and hauled in his lone target for minus-4 yards during the Dolphins' 24-22 loss to the Colts on Sunday.
news.story: Allen found the ball on both of his offensive snaps during Sunday's loss, although he ended up losing four yards on his only catch of the game early in the second quarter. He's well behind Ollie Gordon and Jaylen Wright on the running back depth chart, and most of Allen's playing time in Week 11 against the Bills on Nov. 22, likely will come on special teams.

news.headline: Blue returned his lone kickoff for 23 yards but fumbled the ball in the process during the Eagles' 19-16 win over the Steelers on Sunday.
news.story: The loose ball was recovered by the Steelers, and Pittsburgh's offense turned that takeaway into a 40-yard field goal by Chris Boswell four plays later. It ended up being the only touch of the game for Blue, who played all 11 of his snaps on special teams. There's an outside chance he sees some involvement on offense against the Cowboys on Thanksgiving Day, but that will depend on the availability of both Saquon…

news.headline: The Eagles signed Blue from their practice squad to their active roster Tuesday.
news.story: It's already the third time this season Blue has been signed by Philadelphia from the practice squad to the active roster. The second-year pro has seen action in two games with the club, recording a nine-yard catch on his only touch while racking up 268 yards on 12 kickoff returns. Blue is currently the only healthy running back on the Eagles' active roster aside from starter Saquon Barkley, but that may change…

news.headline: Blue was signed to the Eagles' practice squad Monday.
news.story: Blue was let go by the Eagles after suiting up for the team in Weeks 8 and 9, a span in which he didn't record a carry and caught his only target for nine yards. Now that he's back on the team's practice squad, the 2025 fifth-rounder will give Philadelphia's Saquon Barkley-led RB corps an added depth option ahead of Week 11 action.

news.headline: Prentice (concussion) was a full participant in Wednesday's practice.
news.story: It appears Prentice entered the league's concussion protocol following the Broncos' Week 9 win over the Panthers. He had additional time to recover courtesy of the Week 10 bye, so the veteran fullback should be available for Sunday's AFC West tilt against the Raiders.

news.headline: Wetjen (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Eagles.
news.story: Wetjen has operated as the Steelers' top returner on both kickoffs and punts this season. However, with Roman Wilson back from injured reserve and Max Hurleman elevated from the practice squad to the active roster, Wetjen will be a healthy scratch Sunday for the first time this season. Wetjen's next opportunity to play is Friday against the Broncos, although the rookie fourth-rounder's chances of suiting up for…

news.headline: Davis didn't play an offensive snap in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Chargers.
news.story: As has been the case for three straight weeks, with Breece Hall back healthy, Davis has been glued to special teams for the Jets. He has no fantasy appeal.

news.headline: Davis didn't touch the ball on offense in Sunday's 31-12 loss to the Bills.
news.story: With Breece Hall and Braelon Allen both healthy, Davis has minimal fantasy value, except for leagues that count return yardage. He's played zero offensive snaps over the last two contests, but Davis did return three kickoffs for 74 yards against Buffalo.

news.headline: Fantasy football free agent pickups: Grab your Rams and Packers quickly
Freiermuth caught all five of his targets for 39 yards during Sunday's 19-16 loss to the Eagles.
news.story: Freiermuth matched his season high in catches, securing five passes in a game for the third time this year. The tight end has yet to exceed 50 receiving yards in a contest this season, and he entered Week 11 with exactly two catches in each of the team's last four games. Freiermuth has now caught 32 of 43 targets for 309 yards and five touchdowns while also adding four rushes for five yards and a score over 10…

news.headline: Freiermuth recorded two catches (on three targets) for 35 yards and one touchdown during Sunday's 38-18 loss in Cincinnati.
news.story: Freiermuth was added to the Steelers' injury report Saturday due to an illness that left him questionable for Week 10 action. Ultimately, he avoided inactive status and also made an end-zone visit for the first time since Week 5 on a 27-yard hookup with QB Aaron Rodgers in the fourth quarter. Considering Freiermuth hasn't reached 50 receiving yards in any game this season, he remains a TD-dependent fantasy option…

news.headline: Adkins recorded a three-yard reception on two targets in Sunday's 38-24 win over the Raiders.
news.story: Adkins was on the field for 30 of the Broncos' 73 snaps on offense, with his 41 percent share representing a season-high mark. The fourth-year tight end out of South Carolina has mainly served as a blocking specialist for Denver, having thus far been limited to a 7-47-3 receiving line on nine targets to go with a six-yard carry through 10 appearances on the season.

news.headline: Bell (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Dolphins.
news.story: Bell made his third appearance of the 2026 campaign in Week 10, though he went without a catch. With Tyrell Shavers (knee) cleared to play for Sunday's divisional clash with Miami after spending time on injured reserve, Bell's services won't be needed. His next opportunity to play will come in Week 12 against the Chiefs.

news.headline: Bryant caught three passes for 32 yards on four targets in Sunday's 38-24 win over the Raiders.
news.story: The wideout briefly exited the game in the third quarter after he appeared to tweak his previously injured ankle, but Bryant quickly returned and was able to finish out the contest. His four targets were fourth on the team on a day Bo Nix targeted nine different players on 35 pass attempts. The Denver offense spreads the ball around to five different receivers, three tight ends and its running backs most weeks,…

news.headline: Bryant returned to Sunday's game against the Raiders after making a brief visit to the sideline tent, Zac Stevens of TheDNVR.com reports.
news.story: Bryant's time away from the field occurred in the middle of the third quarter. He'll look to build upon the 3-32-0 line on three targets that he accrued to that point in the contest.

news.headline: What to know to set your lineup: Nix, Ward viable options if your QB is on bye
Saylors recorded 29-yard kick return during Sunday's 31-21 win over Tampa Bay.
news.story: Saylors didn't record any stats over two snaps on offense while he notched 29 yards on his only kick return of the day in Week 11. The running back will continue to be unintriguing fantasy option while operating as an extreme depth option behind Jahmyr Gibbs in Detroit's backfield moving forward.

news.headline: Saylors rushed twice for nine yards while adding 26 yards as a kick returner during Sunday's 35-10 win over the Patriots.
news.story: Saylors played six snaps on offense while serving as a No. 3 option behind Jahmyr Gibbs and Sione Vaki in the backfield. Saylors was on the field for 20 snaps with the special-teams unit, and he'll continue to be primarily a special-teams asset in Week 11 against the Buccaneers.

news.headline: Moreau brought in his lone target for eight yards during the Texans' 26-3 win over the Colts on Thursday.
news.story: Moreau's 30 offensive snaps were second among Texans tight ends behind Dalton Schultz's 34, yet it was Marlin Klein who led the position group with four catches (on as many targets) for 24 yards, including a 13-yard touchdown pass from C.J. Stroud late in the third quarter. Moreau is up to a 12-80-3 receiving line on 15 targets through 10 regular-season games and has caught one pass or zero in five of those…

news.headline: Boerkircher didn't draw a target while playing 22 of the Jaguars' 72 snaps on offense in Sunday's 23-18 loss to the Giants.
news.story: Though quarterback Trevor Lawrence dropped back a season-high 50 times on the day and targeted nine different players, Boerkircher wasn't able to earn a look in the passing game. The second-round rookie out of Texas A&M is regarded mainly as a run-blocking specialist, but he had carved out a minor role in the passing attack with at least one reception in each of Jacksonville's previous six contests.

news.headline: Darnold (quadriceps/ribs) was suited up for Monday's unofficial practice, Bob Condotta of The Seattle Times reports.
news.story: The Seahawks are coming off a Week 11 bye, so they're allowed to hold a session outside of the normal bounds under NFL rules. Darnold sat out Weeks 9 and 10 due to a quad injury and cracked ribs that he sustained during a Week 8 loss to the Bears, but head coach Mike Macdonald has said multiple times in the interim that the team is optimistic that its No. 1 QB will return in Week 12. Wednesday's practice report…

news.headline: Head coach Mike Macdonald said Monday that he's "really optimistic" Darnold (quadriceps/ribs) will be able to get a full week's worth of practice coming out of the Seahawks' Week 11 bye and start their next game Sunday, Nov. 29, against the 49ers, John Boyle…
news.story: Darnold, who last played in Week 8, still is working his way through a pair of injuries, but barring any setbacks, he's trending toward a Week 12 return. Macdonald reiterated that Darnold will be the team's starter once healthy, even though backup Drew Lock has guided Seattle to a 4-0 record while coming on in relief or starting in place of an injured Darnold in the first two games of the season as well as the most…

news.headline: Smith caught both of his targets for 40 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 34-6 win over the Cardinals.
news.story: With the Rams down both Puka Nacua (knee/toe) and Davante Adams (hamstring) for the first time this season, Smith operated as the fourth receiver against Arizona, playing nine of 76 offensive snaps. His 22-yard touchdown in the second quarter was the first of Smith's career. Based on his small amount of playing time and routes run, Smith's 12-point PPR day isn't worth chasing in fantasy.

news.headline: Barkley was listed as a limited participant on Monday's estimated practice report due to a neck injury and an illness.
news.story: Barkley appeared to be nursing a left arm injury in the aftermath of Sunday's 19-16 win over the Steelers, but it was instead two different health concerns that resulted in him being included on the Eagles' first Week 12 injury report. The Eagles are facing a quick turnaround this week with a Thursday matchup against the Cowboys, so Barkley could be in line for only light activity over the next two days as the team…

Barkley (left arm) said after Sunday's 19-16 win over the Steelers that he believes he'll play in Thursday's game at Dallas, Johnny McGonigal of PennLive.com reports.
news.story: Barkley didn't log a touch after the 8:02 mark of the fourth quarter after he had an apparent left arm injury examined by team trainers, according to Olivia Reiner of The Philadelphia Inquirer. While Barkley wouldn't elaborate on the issue to McGonigal, the running back seemed optimistic about his chances to suit up in Week 12. Barkley finished Sunday's matchup with 17 carries for 75 yards and one touchdown and…

Brissett completed 24 of 37 passes for 276 yards and a touchdown with an interception in Sunday's 35-33 loss to the Panthers. He added seven rushing yards on two carries.
news.story: It was another decent showing for the veteran quarterback, and his first TD pass in two games as a Raven came on a trick that involved a direct snap to Derrick Henry, who flipped it Brissett for a 52-yard strike to Rashod Bateman. Brissett has also kept Zay Flowers relevant, feeding the wideout 18 targets for a 14-171-0 line. Baltimore's passing attack will try to keep improving in Week 12 against the Texans.

news.headline: Rest-of-season rankings: Joe Burrow takes QB lead, Chuba Hubbard continues rise
Ali played all 19 of his snaps on special teams in Monday's 23-20 loss to the Chargers.
news.story: For the second week in a row, Ali was deployed exclusively on special teams while the Ravens leaned on Derrick Henry and Justice Hill to handle all the snaps out of the backfield. Ali has logged just seven total snaps on offense all season, carrying six times for 24 yards.

news.headline: Cowing returned one punt for no gain during San Francisco's win over the Vikings on Sunday.
news.story: Cowing saw limited action in the win, playing just six snaps on offense and two on special teams. The 25-year-old hasn't been targeted across the last two games and should continue to serve a depth role with Mike Evans now healthy.

news.headline: Cowing did not draw any targets during Sunday's 46-40 win at Dallas.
news.story: Cowing was also sent back to receive two punts in Week 10, making a fair catch on one and allowing the other to go into the endzone for a touchback. He has now drawn just one target over the two games following his three-catch performance in Week 7, and his role in the 49ers' offense figures to shrink even further once veteran Mike Evans returns from Achilles tendinitis, which could happen as soon as Sunday versus…

news.headline: Moore (ankle) remained limited in Monday's practice.
news.story: Moore re-injured his ankle after just three snaps on special teams in the Packers' Week 10 loss to the Vikings. He's been practicing ahead of Wednesday's game against the Rams, but it remains to be seen if Moore will be able to play. His role on offense has mostly evaporated with the return of Savion Williams behind Matthew Golden and Christian Watson.

news.headline: Moore (ankle) was a limited participant in Sunday's practice, Rob Demovsky of ESPN.com reports.
news.story: Moore tweaked his ankle during the Packers' 30-10 loss to the Vikings in Week 10. He's mostly operated as a returner on kickoffs and punts this season, so those return duties would fall to Savion Williams, Matthew Golden and Bo Melton (thigh) if Moore is unable to play against the Rams on Wednesday.

news.headline: Moore (ankle) participated in practice Saturday, Bill Huber of SI.com reports.
news.story: Moore made his return from injured reserve last Sunday against the Vikings but played just three special-teams snaps before aggravating his existing ankle injury. It's not believed to be a serious issue, and Moore has a chance to play Wednesday versus the Rams.

news.story: Josh Jacobs logged his first official practice Sunday since undergoing finger surgery on Nov. 13, going down as a limited participant. Head coach Matt LaFleur relayed to Wes Hodkiewicz of the team's official site earlier in the day that Jacobs is "gonna have to show a lot of progress" the next few days to be available in Week 12. If Jacobs isn't active Wednesday at the Rams, Johnson may be the favorite to lead…

news.headline: Johnson carried the ball 10 times for 42 yards in Sunday's 30-10 loss to the Vikings.
news.story: The former Steeler led the Packers' backfield in totes and rushing yards, with MarShawn Lloyd chipping in 39 scrimmage yards on seven touches. Johnson has produced modest but decent numbers over the last two games, averaging a 4.6 YPC on 24 carries as the top early-down option for Green Bay. Josh Jacobs (finger) could return after the team's Week 11 bye, but if he isn't cleared, Johnson could find himself atop the…

news.headline: Mingo (ankle/foot) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Titans, Tommy Yarrish of the Cowboys' official site reports.
news.story: It will be the second game that Mingo will miss while recovering from foot and ankle injuries, which have prevented him from practicing over the last two weeks, and his next chance to suit up is Week 12 against the Eagles on Thanksgiving Day. In Mingo's absence, KaVontae Turpin and Camden Brown will be the Cowboys' rotational options at wide receiver behind CeeDee Lamb, George Pickens and Ryan Flournoy.

Mahomes completed 27 of 39 passes for 324 yards with three touchdowns and no interceptions in the Chiefs' 34-7 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.
news.story: Mahomes was clicking early against the Cardinals' defense, capping off the opening possession of the game with an eight-yard touchdown toss to Travis Kelce. The prolific signal-caller went on to add a 22-yard scoring pass to Kelce shortly before the end of the first half, and he capped off his day with an 18-yarder to Xavier Worthy on which the speedy receiver raced up the right sideline and into the end zone.…

Bartholomew caught one of three targets for five yards in Sunday night's 35-10 loss to the 49ers.
news.story: With T.J. Hockenson back in the lineup after being inactive Week 10, Bartholomew played just 18 of 67 offensive snaps as the Vikings' third tight end, also behind Ben Yurosek. Bartholomew has 11 catches for 95 yards and a touchdown on 15 targets across 10 games this season.

news.headline: Bartholomew should revert to a backup role with T.J. Hockenson returning from a wrist injury for Sunday's game against the 49ers, Craig Peters of the Vikings' official site reports.
news.story: Bartholomew was targeted four times in Week 10 for three catches, 36 yards and a touchdown in the Vikings' 30-10 win over the Packers. The tight end received more than one target in only one other game this season, Week 5, when Hockenson went down after two offensive snaps. While Bartholomew has proven himself a red-zone threat, Hockenson should return to seeing most of the tight end volume in Sunday's contest.

news.headline: Bartholomew caught three of four targets for 36 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 30-10 win over the Packers.
news.story: With T.J. Hockenson (wrist) inactive, Bartholomew played 53 of 69 offensive snaps against Green Bay and caught the second of Kirk Cousins' two touchdowns, scoring from 20 yards out in the fourth quarter to give Minnesota a comfortable 27-10 lead. While Ben Yurosek got the start, Bartholomew played 13 more snaps and out-targeted Yurosek four to one. Cousins has an affinity for throwing to his tight ends, so…

news.headline: Smith completed 17 of 21 passes for 176 yards and three touchdowns in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Chargers. He also rushed once for four yards.
news.story: Smith didn't have a completion longer than 21 yards but kept the offense on schedule with an accurate performance. Most importantly, he stepped up in the red zone, which has been the team's Achilles' heel throughout the season. Smith threw a seven-yard touchdown pass to Breece Hall to snap the Jets' two-game touchdown drought in the second quarter, then tacked on touchdown passes of eight and 15 yards to…

Covey (knee) does not have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Steelers.
news.story: Covey was a limited participant in all three practices during Week 11 prep, but the veteran wide receiver has done enough to be cleared to return from a two-game absence due to a knee injury. He'll likely operate as the Eagles' top return option on kickoffs and punts while providing depth at wide receiver.

news.headline: Chestnut played all 25 of his snaps on special teams in Sunday's 40-23 win over the Jaguars.
news.story: The fifth-year running back has suited up for all nine of the Titans' games this season, but he's been deployed almost exclusively on special teams as a member of the team's kick coverage and return units. He's played just two offensive snaps on the campaign and hasn't logged any carries or targets.

news.headline: Allen caught two of four targets for 41 yards during Sunday's 34-7 win over the Cardinals.
news.story: Allen was able to reel in multiple passes for the second straight week after having done so only twice in the team's first eight games of the year. The wide receiver played 16 offensive snaps which ranked sixth at his position behind Xavier Worthy (47), Rashee Rice (32), Jalen Royals (24), Andrew Armstrong (20) and Josh Downs (17). As a result of the depth of the WR room in Kansas City, Allen will remain a hard…

news.headline: Allen caught two of four targets for 44 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 35-13 win over the Falcons.
news.story: The rookie wideout scored his first career touchdown by beating the cornerback on a stutter-go for a 39-yard touchdown in the third quarter. With Josh Downs still getting comfortable and learning the offense following Tuesday's acquisition from the Colts, Allen maintained a significant role on offense, playing 22 of 64 offensive snaps. Once Downs progresses from the 10 snaps he played against Atlanta, it will be…

news.story: Purdy remained effective despite facing the vaunted Vikings defense, which had allowed just six touchdown passes through nine games. news.story: After throwing for no touchdowns or interceptions in his first NFL start last Sunday against the Seahawks, Mendoza recorded the first scoring strike of his career on a 68-yard catch and run via RB Ashton Jeanty in Week 11. Mendoza also hooked up with Ian Thomas (19 yards) and Jack Bech (seven yards) for his other two TDs, but he followed up a 58.6 completion percentage in Week 10 with more misfires (19) than…

news.headline: Penix completed 23 of 43 passes for 286 yards with no touchdowns and one interception and rushed four times for 29 yards in the Falcons' 35-13 loss to the Chiefs on Sunday. He also fumbled once but recovered.
news.story: Penix struggled while the game was still in question, but he did manage to pad his stats some down the stretch as the Falcons unsuccessfully tried to overcome their deficit. Penix connected with eight different targets overall on the afternoon, and he ultimately finished with a season high in passing yards. Penix has now tossed six interceptions in the last three games, however, and he'll look to regroup during the…

news.headline: Milton completed 11 of 21 passes for 141 yards while rushing five times for seven yards in Sunday's 19-16 win over the Steelers.
news.story: Milton has thrown for just 310 yards without a touchdown pass or interception through two starts. He rushed for just seven yards Sunday after notching 64 rushing yards against the Giants in his first start with the Eagles, but Milton avoided mistakes as the Eagles rode their defense and Saquon Barkley's legs to their third win of the season. Twelve of Milton's 21 passes were directed to DeVonta Smith (hamstring) in…

news.headline: Head coach Nick Sirianni confirmed that Milton will remain the Eagles' starting quarterback for Sunday's game against the Steelers, according to NFL reporter Andrew Siciliano.
news.story: While starting in his team debut Week 9 against the Giants, Milton was unable to bring an end to the Eagles' lengthy losing streak, but the third-year quarterback showed enough positives to retain the starting gig coming out of a Week 10 bye. Milton put an intriguing dual-threat skill set on display with 64 yards on nine carries to go with 169 passing yards on 34 attempts in the 19-11 loss to New York, with the…

news.headline: Franklin did not record a catch in Sunday's 38-24 win over the Raiders.
news.story: The wide receiver did see two targets, but he wasn't able to haul them in. Franklin has just 17 targets across 10 games this year, making nine catches for 100 yards and no scores.

news.headline: Coleman failed to catch his lone target in Sunday's 26-9 loss to the Bills.
news.story: With Chris Bell (knee) back from his absence, Coleman reverted to WR4 duties for Miami, playing just 12 of 57 offensive snaps. He has no fantasy appeal while Caleb Douglas, Malik Washington and Bell are healthy. Coleman has been extremely inefficient through 10 games this season, catching just nine of 28 targets for 88 yards and two touchdowns.

news.headline: Coleman logged one catch for six yards on six targets in Sunday's Week 10 loss to Indianapolis.
news.story: Coleman couldn't get on the same page as QB Kyle McCord, who made his first NFL regular-season appearance. In fact, Coleman has been quiet inefficient regardless of who has thrown him the ball this year, as he has just nine receptions on 27 targets through nine games. Two of his nine catches have been touchdowns, but he's not getting enough touches to be a trustworthy fantasy option.

news.headline: Cooper caught four of his five targets for 59 yards in the Eagles' 19-16 win over the Steelers on Sunday.
news.story: Cooper played 46 offensive snaps and 15 special-teams snaps in Sunday's contest. The wide receiver continues to play most of the offensive snaps for the Eagles, seeing two more targets than rookie first-round pick Makai Lemon in the Week 11 win.

news.headline: Harrison (hamstring) has been ruled out for Thursday night's game against the Colts.
news.story: Harrison was also inactive for this past Sunday's game against the Browns, and he will now target a potential return to action Nov. 29 versus the Ravens following Houston's Week 11 bye. In his continued absence, Nico Collins, Xavier Hutchinson, Kayshon Boutte and Tank Dell will handle the Texans' WR duties Thursday. Collins (16 targets, nine catches) and Hutchinson (nine targets, four catches) combined for 152…

news.headline: Harrison (hamstring) was a non-participant in Tuesday's practice.
news.story: While the Texans haven't provided a definitive word on Harrison's status for Thursday's game against the Colts, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston relays that the 24-year-old wideout is trending toward missing a second straight contest now that he's yet to practice in any fashion this week. Since being acquired from the Cardinals in October, Harrison has suited up in three games for Houston and has recorded six catches…

news.headline: Harrison (hamstring) was estimated as a non-participant on Monday's practice report.
news.story: After missing Sunday's loss to the Browns, Harrison opened the new week with another missed practice due to his hamstring issue. If he's unable to return in time for Thursday night's game against the Colts on a short week, Nico Collins, Xavier Hutchinson, Kayshon Boutte and Tank Dell likely will soak up the vast majority of the snaps at wideout.

news.headline: Tolbert caught his only target for 17 yards during Sunday's 26-9 loss at Buffalo.
news.story: Tolbert played just eight of the Dolphins' 55 offensive snaps in Week 11, and he drew just one target for the third time in his last five games. Miami will probably continue to lean primarily on Malik Washington, Caleb Douglas and Chris Bell at wide receiver in a Week 12 matchup versus the Jets.

news.headline: Tolbert caught both of his targets for 49 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 24-22 loss to the Colts.
news.story: The wideout was active for just the fifth time in nine games this season and played 11 of 69 offensive snaps. He ran only five routes and caught a 34-yard touchdown from fellow receiver Malik Washington on a trick play early in the second quarter. Tolbert has no fantasy appeal moving forward, as he has just four catches for 79 yards on six targets this season.

news.story: Dulin played 22 offensive snaps and 10 special-teams snaps in the contest. The No. 4 wide receiver saw plenty of attention, catching 50 percent of his targets to accumulate the second-highest receiving yardage for the Colts, behind Anthony Gould's 48 yards.

news.headline: Dulin caught one of two targets for 30 yards and returned three kickoffs for 77 yards during the Colts' 24-22 win over the Dolphins on Sunday. He also recorded two tackles on special teams.
news.story: Even with Josh Downs and Keenan Allen being sent out at the Nov. 10 trade deadline, Dulin's 13 offensive snaps were fourth-most among Colts wide receivers behind Laquon Treadwell (52), Deion Burks (34) and Anthony Gould (32). Dulin did connect on a 30-yard pass from Daniel Jones late in the second quarter, which was a pivotal part of a nine-play, 92-yard drive that ended with a seven-yard touchdown catch by…

news.story: It was Brooks' first action since Week 4 after spending five games on injured reserve with a high-ankle sprain. news.headline: Brooks (ankle) is active for Sunday's game versus the Vikings, Mike Spofford of the Packers' official site reports.
news.story: Brooks is back after a five-game stint on injured reserve due to an ankle issue that he suffered in Week 4. news.headline: Green Bay activated Brooks (ankle) from injured reserve Saturday, though he is still questionable for Sunday's Week 10 clash against the Vikings.
news.story: Brooks has missed the required four contests after being placed on injured reserve Oct. 10. He was limited in all three practices this week, and it remains to be seen if he'll suit up Sunday. If Brooks does play, he'll help make up for the backfield absence of Josh Jacobs, who has been ruled out due to a finger injury. MarShawn Lloyd, Kaleb Johnson and Pierre Strong are the Packers' current healthy RBs.

news.headline: Jones (shoulder) does not have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the 49ers in Mexico City.
news.story: Jones -- who was managing a shoulder injury during Week 11 prep -- was a full participant in Friday's session, which was enough for him to avoid an injury tag for Sunday's contest. He was signed to the Vikings' 53-man roster Wednesday to give the team more depth at wide receiver while Jordan Addison recovers from a thumb injury. Jones figures to be limited to a rotational role on offense while serving as a…

news.headline: The Vikings signed Jones (shoulder) off the practice squad to the active roster Wednesday.
news.story: Jones was elevated from the Vikings' practice squad to the active roster for both Week 5 and Week 10 against the Saints and Packers, respectively, and he'll now be part of Minnesota's 53-man roster moving forward. news.story: Jones was elevated to the active roster to help fill in for Jordan Addison (thumb) and Jauan Jennings (calf) in Sunday's 30-10 win over the Packers, but he didn't record any stats while playing six snaps on offense and 11 with the special-teams unit. news.headline: Pittman (foot) is not expected to be activated from injured reserve for Sunday's game against the Eagles, Brooke Pryor of ESPN reports.
news.story: Pittman was able to practice fully both Thursday and Friday, but he is not ready to rejoin the mix just yet -- which Pittsburgh confirmed by omitting Pittman from the list of roster moves it made Saturday. Barring an unannounced setback, Pittman figures to continue practicing, and his next chance to take the field will arrive Black Friday, when the Steelers square off against the Broncos.

news.story: Pittman was designated for return from injured reserve earlier this week and had progressed to full participation Thursday, so his questionable tag keeps him in the mix for a potential activation ahead of Sunday's contest against the Eagles. news.story: Ott logged 12 offensive snaps and eight special-teams snaps in Sunday's contest. The running back saw a few carries behind Emmett Johnson due to the absence of Kenneth Walker (groin). With Walker likely returning for Thursday night against the Bills, Ott will likely return to seeing no offensive snaps.

news.story: Ott was unable to play against the Falcons in Week 10 due to a hamstring injury. If Kenneth Walker (groin) cannot play in Week 11, then Ott would have the opportunity to serve as the Chiefs' RB2 behind rookie fifth-rounder Emmett Johnson.

news.story: Even with the Bills having a quick Week 12 turnaround ahead of Thursday night's game against the Chiefs on Thanksgiving, Buffalo rode James Cook and handed him 22 carries rather than spelling him a little more ahead of a short week. Davis has handled 17 carries across 10 games this season, turning them into a measly 55 yards and no touchdowns. His only fantasy value is being Cook's backup.

news.headline: Davis (hamstring) doesn't have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Dolphins.
news.story: The backup running back was managed during the practice week but is good to go for his normal role behind lead back James Cook. With the Bills listed as 16.5-point favorites, Davis could see some extra reps in garbage time if Buffalo does indeed blow out Miami.

news.headline: Davis (hamstring) remained limited in Thursday's practice.
news.story: It's a new injury for the running back, which clouds his status for Week 11 against the Dolphins. If Davis is unable to handle his normal handful of snaps, Frank Gore could be elevated from the practice squad.

news.story: Trautman leaked open behind Las Vegas' defense on a play-action pass from the goal line early in the second quarter, giving Denver a 10-0 lead. He still has a big role in the Broncos' offense, but he isn't running enough routes to sustain pass-catching production worth fantasy consideration in most formats.

If he needs to miss time, Allen could see elevated snaps behind Rodriguez, though Ameer Abdullah is also an option for the Jaguars out of the backfield. Ultimately, Allen is much likelier than not to remain irrelevant in fantasy.

news.headline: Allen (hamstring) doesn't have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Giants.
news.story: Allen has next to no fantasy appeal having played a total of 73 offensive snaps this season. In nine games, he's touched the ball a total of three times on offense.

news.story: Allen is one of three Jaguars running backs on the Week 11 injury report, with Bhayshul Tuten (ankle/foot) and Chris Rodriguez (hand) also tending to health concerns. After being listed as a non-participant Thursday, Tuten appears to be more at risk of sitting out Sunday against the Giants than either Allen or Rodriguez, both of whom have been limited in the Jaguars' first two Week 11 practices.

news.story: Melton's practice reps Sunday were limited due to a thigh injury that he sustained in Week 10 against the Vikings. His practice participation over the coming days will shed light on his chances of playing Wednesday against the Rams.

news.headline: Melton (thigh) has been ruled out for the rest of Sunday's game against the Vikings, Rob Demovsky of ESPN.com reports.
news.story: Melton exited Sunday's game because of a thigh injury, and he will not be cleared to return to the contest. Skyy Moore (ankle) will also not return, so Savion Williams and Matthew Golden will operate as the top return options on kickoffs and punts.

news.story: Walker showed up at the Chiefs' facilities last Friday with a tight groin and eventually was ruled out for this past Sunday's game in Atlanta. With no practice reps to speak of yet during Week 11 prep, he appears to be trending toward another absence this Sunday, which again will thrust rookie Emmett Johnson into a workhorse role out of Kansas City's backfield.

news.headline: Williams (toe) was a limited practice participant Sunday, Adam Caplan of SiriusXM NFL Radio reports.
news.story: Head coach Sean McVay relayed to Sarah Barshop of ESPN.com on Saturday that Williams is dealing with a sore toe, so his practice restrictions to begin Week 12 prep aren't a surprise. Williams will have two more chances to put himself in a position to avoid a designation for Wednesday's game against the Packers.

news.headline: Head coach Sean McVay said Saturday that Williams is tending to a sore toe but is expected to play Wednesday against the Packers, Sarah Barshop of ESPN reports.
news.story: The Rams are in the midst of their Week 11 bye, but with a Wednesday game on tap in Week 12, the team is getting back on the practice field this weekend. He'll have three more days to work through the new health concern, but considering McVay's comments, Williams should be fine to continue to work in tandem with fellow RB Blake Corum.

news.story: Pittman was able to practice fully both Thursday and Friday, but he is not ready to rejoin the mix just yet -- which Pittsburgh confirmed by omitting Pittman from the list of roster moves it made Saturday. Barring an unannounced setback, Pittman figures to continue practicing, and his next chance to take the field will arrive Black Friday, when the Steelers square off against the Broncos.

news.headline: Waddle (concussion) doesn't carry an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Raiders after practicing fully this week.
news.story: Waddle was limited to just 14 snaps and one catch for 22 yards before exiting the Broncos' Week 9 win over the Panthers with a concussion. Following a well-time Week 10 bye, Waddle has progressed through the NFL's concussion protocol, ensuring that Denver's top pass catcher -- who has recorded a 30/337/2 receiving line on 52 targets through nine contests -- will be available this weekend.

news.headline: Waddle (concussion) was a full practice participant Thursday.
news.story: A full practice participant for the second day in a row, Waddle looks to be close to clearing the NFL's concussion protocol after he sustained the head injury in a Nov. 8 win over the Panthers. Assuming he can receive clearance from an independent neurologist by the weekend, Waddle will be removed from the protocol and suit up Sunday versus the Raiders.

Schoonmaker has five catches for 48 yards on six targets across nine games this season and has no fantasy appeal.

news.headline: The Cowboys signed Mitchell from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday, Tommy Yarrish of the team's official site reports.
news.story: The Cowboys technically still have one elevation to use on Mitchell this season, but they instead will opt to sign him to the active roster for Week 10. His signing gives the Cowboys extra depth at tight end, as the team will be without Jake Ferguson (knee) for Sunday's game against the 49ers.

news.headline: Ferguson (knee/ankle) was listed as a non-participant on Monday's practice estimate, Tommy Yarrish of the Cowboys' official site reports.

news.story: Knox was the top available TE for the Bills in the absence of Dalton Kincaid (thumb/ankle). He hasn't scored since Week 2 while recording a meager 117 yards on 16 catches through 10 games.

news.headline: Knox will likely be the Bills' top tight end against the Dolphins on Sunday, given that Dalton Kincaid (thumb/ankle) is listed as doubtful for that contest, Maddy Glab of the Bills' official site reports.

news.story: Knox continues to receive targets as the No. 2 tight end in the Bills offense. The 30-year-old has consistently struggled to bring in catchable balls over the past few contests but remains a valuable part of Buffalo's 13-personnel packages as a blocker and receiving threat.
